race_description.description: Human humanoid anatomy: one torso, head and back; two arms and hands; a paired-feet group. Physical mutations require their actual body variant.
race_description.description_kind: Source-derived anatomy summary; native Humanoid has no race-wide Description.Short. No occupation or named posture inferred.

captured_actor.description: Sharp jade eyes are crow-worn to late middle age and her lips are scarred with gas burns. Climbing over her back and neck are the jeweled segments of a great spiral tail and stinger; a bead of smoking gut juice gleams on the tip.

equipped.description:
The crown is crushed by wear into a hundred papery creases, and the brim is stained in the fractal signatures of sweat and salt.

{{K|Weight: 1 lbs.}}

A pair of strapped shoes are cracked on the soles in sinelike patterns of gravel walking.

{{K|Weight: 1 lbs.}}

A phosphorescent opal-like fits in the palm of a hand and glows with the light of auroras absorbed chiliads ago. It floats about preternaturally.

anatomy.part_mapping: Arm/Hand IDs and managers are retained as mechanical anatomy/equipment data, not render bones. Extra pair artwork is a neutral authored posture. Actual Pestle Hand181/6 and FloatingNearby195 remain individual assembly work.

scope.source_anatomy: Captured four arms/hands and Tail193 managed by Stinger. Native description specifies great jeweled segmented spiral tail climbing over back/neck with a stinger and small bead at its tip. Extra pair/tail remain separate from the existing unmutated human-female body.
scope.age_and_cosmetics: Late middle age is explicit description, not a captured numeric age field. Jade eyes/scarred lips/personal facial detail remain metadata under the agreed initial cosmetic boundary; do not invent an occupation body or infer a different demographic.
scope.equipment: Leather Apron529 Body176, Wide-brimmed Hat530 Head177, Pestle531 changed Hand181/6, Sandals536 Feet192, Floating Glowsphere538 FloatingNearby195/0. Natural fists/stinger defaults are not additional worn objects.
scope.floating_item: Glowsphere is actually in Floating Nearby195, not a Hand slot. Preserve that distinction; the one-handed floating-object palm rule does not rename its captured slot.
scope.native_boundary: No new framework, game launch or native validation; real mutation/attachment/pose/state acceptance remains behind the all-generation gate.

frame.method: Exact RGBA paste at integer y+240. No body resampling; physical pixel scale and ground remain identical. All equipment must inherit the same padding.

authored_interpretation: Tail length/radius, one ascending turn, segment count, facets, limb placement and unseen surfaces are authored from great/spiral/jeweled source cues. Segments are surface construction, not additional mechanical body parts. Do not infer exact dimensions or count from the tiny glyph.
depth: All tail views derive from one 3D centreline with cardinal orthographic projection. Split tail geometry by near/far side of the fixed body plane; retain the complete tail independently of final clothing masks.
native_acceptance: Pending full-set generation and actual named anatomy/equipment/visibility/hurt/look/save/native held-state review.
